intro: A visual dictionary of everyday things. Select a numbered part to read what it is called, then open the word in the dictionary. Words that appear in an illustration also show an “Illustrated in” link in their dictionary entry.

items.title: Umbrella
items.summary: The parts of an open umbrella. The ribs are the thin rods that hold the canopy open.

parts.label: canopy
parts.definition: The fabric top of an umbrella that keeps the rain off.

parts.label: rib
parts.definition: One of the thin rods that support an umbrella's canopy.
parts.note: This is the umbrella sense, not the body bone.

parts.label: shaft
parts.definition: The long central pole of an umbrella.

parts.label: handle
parts.definition: The part you hold at the bottom of an umbrella.

parts.label: ferrule
parts.definition: The small cap at the very top of an umbrella.

parts.label: runner
parts.definition: The sliding ring that pushes the ribs open and holds them up.

parts.label: stretcher
parts.definition: A hinged strut that connects the runner to a rib.

parts.label: tie
parts.definition: A small strap that keeps a folded umbrella closed.

parts.label: tip
parts.definition: The pointed end at the bottom of an umbrella.

items.title: Bicycle
items.summary: A bicycle has two wheels, a frame, a drive chain, and controls for steering and braking.

parts.label: wheel
parts.definition: The round part that turns and carries the bicycle.

parts.label: tyre / tire
parts.definition: The rubber ring around a wheel.

parts.label: rim
parts.definition: The metal hoop that holds the tyre and spokes.

parts.label: spoke
parts.definition: One of the thin rods connecting the hub to the rim.

parts.label: hub
parts.definition: The central part of a wheel, where the spokes meet.

parts.label: frame
parts.definition: The main metal structure that joins the wheels, seat, and handlebars.

parts.label: handlebar
parts.definition: The bar you hold to steer the bicycle.

parts.label: saddle
parts.definition: The seat of a bicycle.

parts.label: pedal
parts.definition: The part you push with your foot to turn the chain.

parts.label: chain
parts.definition: The metal loop that carries power from the pedals to the rear wheel.

parts.label: gear
parts.definition: A toothed wheel that changes how hard it is to pedal.

items.title: Car
items.summary: The main outside parts of a passenger car.

parts.label: hood / bonnet
parts.definition: The front cover over the engine. In British English it is usually called the bonnet.

parts.label: roof
parts.definition: The top cover of the car's passenger compartment.

parts.label: windshield
parts.definition: The front window. British English usually says windscreen.

parts.label: window
parts.definition: A glass opening in the side of the car.

parts.label: door
parts.definition: The hinged panel you open to get into the car.

parts.label: mirror
parts.definition: A small mirror that lets the driver see behind.

parts.label: wheel
parts.definition: The round part that the tyre is fitted to.

parts.label: tyre / tire
parts.definition: The rubber ring around a wheel.

parts.label: headlight
parts.definition: A bright light at the front of the car.

parts.label: grille
parts.definition: The slatted opening at the front that lets air reach the engine.

parts.label: bumper
parts.definition: The protective bar at the front or back of a car.

parts.label: trunk / boot
parts.definition: The luggage compartment at the back. British English usually says boot.

parts.label: roof
parts.definition: The covering on top of a building.

parts.label: chimney
parts.definition: The tall pipe that carries smoke from a fire out of the house.

parts.label: gutter
parts.definition: The channel along the edge of a roof that collects rainwater.

parts.label: wall
parts.definition: The upright side of a building.

parts.label: window
parts.definition: An opening with glass that lets in light.

parts.label: door
parts.definition: The moving panel you use to enter a building.

parts.label: porch
parts.definition: A covered area at the entrance of a house.

parts.label: step
parts.definition: A raised surface you walk on to reach a door.

parts.label: foundation
parts.definition: The solid base under a building.

items.title: Human head
items.summary: The main visible parts of a human head and face.

parts.label: hair
parts.definition: The strands growing from the scalp.

parts.label: forehead
parts.definition: The part of the face above the eyebrows.

parts.label: eyebrow
parts.definition: The line of hair above an eye.

parts.label: eye
parts.definition: The organ you see with.

parts.label: eyelash
parts.definition: One of the short hairs along the edge of an eyelid.

parts.label: ear
parts.definition: The part of the body you hear with.

parts.label: cheek
parts.definition: The soft side of the face below the eye.

parts.label: nose
parts.definition: The part of the face used for breathing and smelling.

parts.label: mouth
parts.definition: The opening in the face used for eating and speaking.

parts.label: lip
parts.definition: One of the two soft edges of the mouth.

parts.label: chin
parts.definition: The part of the face below the mouth.

parts.label: jaw
parts.definition: The lower bone of the face that holds the teeth.

items.title: Hand
items.summary: The parts of a human hand.

parts.label: palm
parts.definition: The flat inner surface of the hand.

parts.label: wrist
parts.definition: The joint between the hand and the arm.

parts.label: thumb
parts.definition: The short, thick first finger on the side of the hand.

parts.label: index finger
parts.definition: The finger next to the thumb, often used for pointing.

parts.label: middle finger
parts.definition: The longest finger, in the middle of the hand.

parts.label: ring finger
parts.definition: The finger next to the little finger, where a ring is often worn.

parts.label: little finger
parts.definition: The smallest finger on the outside of the hand.

parts.label: knuckle
parts.definition: A joint where a finger bends.

parts.label: fingernail
parts.definition: The hard protective plate on the end of a finger.

items.title: Tree
items.summary: The main parts of a tree.

parts.label: crown
parts.definition: The mass of branches and leaves at the top of a tree.

parts.label: leaf
parts.definition: A flat green part of a plant that makes food from sunlight.

parts.label: branch
parts.definition: A woody part growing out from the trunk.

parts.label: twig
parts.definition: A very small, thin branch.

parts.label: trunk
parts.definition: The thick main stem of a tree.

parts.label: bark
parts.definition: The tough outer covering of a tree trunk.

parts.label: root
parts.definition: The part of a plant that grows underground and takes in water.

parts.label: petal
parts.definition: One of the coloured leaves around the centre of a flower.

parts.label: stamen
parts.definition: The part of a flower that produces pollen.

parts.label: pistil
parts.definition: The female part of a flower, which receives pollen.

parts.label: sepal
parts.definition: One of the small leaves that protect a flower bud.

parts.label: stem
parts.definition: The long thin part that supports a flower.

parts.label: leaf
parts.definition: A flat green part of a plant.

parts.label: root
parts.definition: The part of a plant that grows underground.

parts.label: bud
parts.definition: A small part that will open into a flower or leaf.

parts.label: screen
parts.definition: The flat display that shows images and text.

parts.label: webcam
parts.definition: A small camera built into a laptop for video calls.

parts.label: hinge
parts.definition: The joint that lets the screen fold closed.

parts.label: keyboard
parts.definition: The set of keys used for typing.

parts.label: trackpad
parts.definition: The flat surface used to move the pointer instead of a mouse.

parts.label: port
parts.definition: A socket for connecting a cable or device.

parts.label: base
parts.definition: The lower part of a laptop that holds the keyboard and electronics.

parts.label: power button
parts.definition: The button that turns the computer on or off.

items.title: Guitar
items.summary: The parts of an acoustic guitar.

parts.label: headstock
parts.definition: The top part of a guitar where the strings are tuned.

parts.label: tuning peg
parts.definition: A peg you turn to tighten or loosen a string.

parts.label: nut
parts.definition: The small strip at the top of the neck that holds the strings in place.

parts.label: neck
parts.definition: The long part between the headstock and the body.

parts.label: fret
parts.definition: A raised strip on the neck that marks a note position.

parts.label: string
parts.definition: One of the thin wires that vibrate to make sound.

parts.label: sound hole
parts.definition: The round opening in the body that lets sound out.

parts.label: body
parts.definition: The large hollow part that amplifies the sound.

parts.label: bridge
parts.definition: The part that holds the strings at the lower end.

items.title: Shoe
items.summary: The parts of a lace-up shoe.

parts.label: sole
parts.definition: The bottom part of a shoe that touches the ground.

parts.label: heel
parts.definition: The back part of the sole under the heel of the foot.

parts.label: toe / toe box
parts.definition: The front part of a shoe that covers the toes.

parts.label: upper
parts.definition: The part of a shoe above the sole.

parts.label: tongue
parts.definition: The flap under the laces that covers the top of the foot.

parts.label: lace
parts.definition: A cord used to tie a shoe.

parts.label: eyelet
parts.definition: A small hole that a shoelace passes through.

parts.label: insole
parts.definition: The soft inside layer under the foot.

parts.label: collar
parts.definition: The padded edge around the opening of a shoe.

parts.label: cap
parts.definition: The lid that closes a bottle.

parts.label: mouth
parts.definition: The opening at the top of a bottle.

parts.label: neck
parts.definition: The narrow part between the mouth and the body.

parts.label: shoulder
parts.definition: The sloping part where the neck widens into the body.

parts.label: body
parts.definition: The main container part of a bottle.

parts.label: label
parts.definition: The printed piece of paper on a bottle that gives information.

parts.label: base
parts.definition: The flat bottom of a bottle.

parts.label: lens
parts.definition: The glass part that focuses light to make a picture.

parts.label: shutter button
parts.definition: The button you press to take a photograph.

parts.label: flash
parts.definition: A bright light that helps take pictures in the dark.

parts.label: viewfinder
parts.definition: The small window you look through to frame a picture.

parts.label: body
parts.definition: The main case that holds the camera parts.

parts.label: grip
parts.definition: The shaped part you hold with your right hand.

parts.label: mode dial
parts.definition: The dial used to choose a shooting mode.

parts.label: tripod mount
parts.definition: The threaded hole for attaching a tripod.

parts.label: face / dial
parts.definition: The flat surface with the numbers on a clock.

parts.label: hour hand
parts.definition: The short hand that shows the hour.

parts.label: minute hand
parts.definition: The long hand that shows the minutes.

parts.label: second hand
parts.definition: The thin hand that moves around once a minute.

parts.label: numeral
parts.definition: One of the numbers on a clock face.

parts.label: bezel
parts.definition: The ring around the glass of a clock or watch.

parts.label: crown
parts.definition: The small knob used to set the time.

parts.label: glass / crystal
parts.definition: The clear cover that protects the clock face.
